## Conceptual correctness — fix these first

Unsound or contradictory concepts in the plan's design — the highest-priority gaps, addressed before the completeness gaps below. The audit reports these but does not apply them (read-only-audit split, #85): the paired apply verb walks them first, before the completeness gaps. Address them with:

    plan-tool completeness-apply roadmap-immutable-candidate-versions   # walk + apply each correctness gap, then the completeness gaps

- HIGH `[feedback-lineage-singleton]` [confidence: limited]: Architecture’s “one expansion budget belongs to the entire feedback lineage” has no stable lineage admission rule. Step 4 (`Build one lineage-bounded candidate context with a single recorded expansion`) accepts any open `FeedbackRow`; step 5 (`Apply capsule-authorized deltas into complete gate-checked candidates and bind their deterministic diffs`) preserves feedback rows unchanged; step 6 (`Run the initial bounded candidate proposal within the lineage's one-expansion budget and store only a gate-clean inert version`) stores no singleton lineage claim; step 7 (`Generate diff-anchored questions, record reviewer answers, and request replacements from the same predecessor`) only follows a selected candidate; and step 11 (`Expose enrollment, candidate review, answers, and promotion in roadmap CLI without changing the HTML overwrite or other modes`) exposes repeatable `--propose-candidate`. At HEAD, `plan_tool/roadmap_artifacts.py:FeedbackRow` keeps `OPEN` feedback active, so a promoted candidate still carries the same eligible request and repeated proposals from the same predecessor can create separate branches and each spend an expansion.
  - Fix: define and persist one immutable feedback-lineage admission and terminal-consumption rule, then make proposal, replacement, and CLI entry points enforce it without mutating stored feedback bytes.
- HIGH `[answer-replacement-resumption]` [confidence: limited]: Architecture’s “every question requires a reviewer-owned answer, and an answer requires a replacement candidate” cannot finish after a replacement failure. Step 7 (`Generate diff-anchored questions, record reviewer answers, and request replacements from the same predecessor`) stores the immutable answer before requesting the replacement, returns `failed` for invocation or persistence failure, and refuses a second answer for the same question; step 11 (`Expose enrollment, candidate review, answers, and promotion in roadmap CLI without changing the HTML overwrite or other modes`) offers only `--answer-question <question-id> --answer <text>`. A transient failure after answer storage therefore leaves an unsealable lineage with no allowed manual continuation.
  - Fix: define an idempotent, user-triggered replacement continuation that reuses the stored immutable answer and exact lineage inputs without allowing the answer to change.
